title: Nine-Tailed Fox Sorceress
description: A female fox spirit with nine flowing white and blue tails leaps dynamically through a dark forest. She wears a red and white traditional outfit, casts a swirling blue energy orb with one hand while red flame-like spirits trail behind her.
prompt: A beautiful female fox spirit with long black hair and fox ears leaping gracefully through a misty dark forest at night, nine large flowing white and blue ethereal tails swirling around her, wearing a detailed red and white traditional East Asian outfit with gold accents, one arm extended casting a powerful swirling blue energy orb with light trails, red flame spirits floating nearby, pink petals and glowing particles in the air, dramatic purple and blue atmospheric lighting, highly detailed fantasy digital art
